# How a lead is scored

Policy version `2026.08.21-1`. Each lead is scored out of 100 from the parts below, then penalties are taken off. A campaign's bar (70 unless configured otherwise) decides who is written to. A trained lead-propensity model (M3) may replace this score only once it beats it on held-out leads, with the operator's approval.

| Part | Weight |
|---|---|
| finding severity | 18 |
| contact quality | 15 |
| modernisation gap | 12 |
| service fit | 10 |
| industry fit | 8 |
| finding confidence | 8 |
| commercial impact | 8 |
| business activity | 8 |
| opportunity breadth | 5 |
| decision maker | 5 |
| geographic fit | 3 |
| **Total** | **100** |

Penalties: compliance risk -25, outreach risk -10.
